name: Abades (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Abades (a crozier on blue and an aqueduct on red).
history: Abades adopted its arms and flag officially on 21 May 1996, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 19 September 1996; the municipal flag is square, of proportion 1:1, red, with a white saltire charged at its centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: Abades arms — crozier on blue and aqueduct on red
